clusters.pick_reason: PR #2215 applies the same /\/+$/ regex fix to both buildWellKnownPath and buildDiscoveryUrls, and additionally fixes the shouldAttemptFallback root-path guard (pathname === '' instead of pathname === '/'), which is a correctness bug introduced by the normalization itself: after replace(/\/+$/, ''), a root URL's pathname becomes '' not '/', so #2214's guard would never fire at root and could cause redundant fallback attempts. #2215 also extracts a normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper to keep the two call sites consistent.
